name: notesx
description: NOTESX — study platform for college students. Root tooling: run client + server with one command.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.seed: npm run seed:notes --prefix server && npm run seed:community --prefix server && npm run seed:doubts --prefix server && npm run seed:jobs --prefix server && npm run seed:roadmaps --prefix server && npm run seed:build --prefix server && npm run seed:gate --prefix server
